name: @pipeworx/mcp-wipo-pearl

tools.name: pearl_search_terms
tools.description: Search WIPO Pearl for a scientific, technical, or IP legal term and get back matching concept records (concept id, the matched term text, subject field). Use `pearl_concept` on a returned concept_id to get the full record: validated equivalents in other languages, reliability rating, defining context and source. Example: pearl_search_terms({ term: "inter partes review", target_languages: ["FR", "JA"], subject_field: "LEGL" }).

term.description: The word or phrase to search for, e.g. "circuit" or "inter partes review".

source_language.description: ISO 639-1 language the term itself is in: AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH. Omit to search across all languages.

target_languages.description: ISO 639-1 languages to return equivalents in (subset of AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH). Omit for all available.

subject_field.description: Restrict to one WIPO Pearl subject-field code (see pearl_subject_fields for the full list), e.g. "LEGL", "CHEM", "ELEC". Omit to search every field.

exact_search.description: Match the search term exactly rather than fuzzily.

limit.description: Maximum concept records to return (default 10, max 50).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Pipeworx supplies a WIPO Business Partner Portal credential automatically. Pass your own as JSON: '{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."}' to use a dedicated subscription instead.

tools.name: pearl_concept
tools.description: Retrieve the full WIPO Pearl database record for one concept_id (from pearl_search_terms): validated term equivalents grouped by language, each with a reliability rating, a defining context, a usage note, and its source. Example: pearl_concept({ concept_id: "8818607" }).

concept_id.description: The record id returned by pearl_search_terms, e.g. "8818607".

lang_code.description: Optional: restrict the record to one ISO 639-1 language (AR, DE, EN, ES, FR, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Pipeworx supplies a WIPO Business Partner Portal credential automatically. Pass your own as JSON: '{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."}' to use a dedicated subscription instead.

tools.name: pearl_subject_fields
tools.description: List the 29 WIPO Pearl subject-field codes (e.g. "LEGL" = Legal Matters, "CHEM" = Chemical & Materials Technology) and the 10 supported language codes, for use with pearl_search_terms' subject_field/source_language/target_languages arguments. No arguments.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wipo-pearl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wipo-pearl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
